field_conventions.ion_stage: 1 denotes a neutral atom, 2 a singly ionized atom, 3 a doubly ionized atom
field_conventions.wavelength_air_angstrom: observed laboratory air wavelength in Angstrom
field_conventions.lower_excitation_ev: lower-level excitation above the ion ground state in eV
field_conventions.log_gf: base-10 logarithm of lower statistical weight times absorption oscillator strength
field_conventions.log_gamma_rad_s: base-10 adopted radiative damping rate in s^-1; the current values use the documented SIR classical prescription rather than an unavailable measured total upper-level lifetime
field_conventions.log_gamma_stark_s_cm3: base-10 Stark rate per electron density in (s^-1)/(cm^-3) at 10000 K; null means deliberately neglected
field_conventions.stark_temperature_exponent: power applied to T/10000 K; null when Stark damping is omitted
field_conventions.abo_sigma_a0_squared: ABO neutral-H broadening cross section at 10 km/s in Bohr-radius squared

NIST_ASD_5_12_LINES.citation: Kramida et al., NIST Atomic Spectra Database, version 5.12
NIST_ASD_5_12_LINES.use: observed air wavelengths, lower excitation energies, J values, and the 6301-A log(gf)

NIST_ASD_5_12_FEI_6173.citation: Kramida et al., NIST Atomic Spectra Database, version 5.12
NIST_ASD_5_12_FEI_6173.use: observed air wavelength, excitation energies, log(gf), configurations, terms, and J values for Fe I 6173

NIST_ASD_5_12_LEVELS.citation: Kramida et al., NIST Atomic Spectra Database, version 5.12
NIST_ASD_5_12_LEVELS.use: experimental Lande factors for the three non-J-zero transition levels

SPIN4D_SIR_TABLE3.citation: Yang et al. 2024, Astrophysical Journal 976, 204, Table 3
SPIN4D_SIR_TABLE3.use: published SIR synthesis choices for the 6302-A log(gf) and ABO sigma/alpha values; these are adopted model inputs, not claimed as unique laboratory determinations

ABO_CROSS_2_0_FEI_6173.interpolation: natural bicubic spline used by retcross.f over the pinned spdata.dat table
ABO_CROSS_2_0_FEI_6173.use: ABO neutral-H cross section and velocity exponent for Fe I 6173

NIST_ZEEMAN_J_ZERO.title: NIST Atomic Spectroscopy: Zeeman Effect
NIST_ZEEMAN_J_ZERO.use: For J=0 the only magnetic sublevel has M=0, so its g*M energy shift is identically zero; the stored numerical g=0 is a harmless computational convention, not an experimental Landé measurement

SIR2015_CLASSICAL_RADIATIVE.title: SIR 2015 classical radiative damping prescription
SIR2015_CLASSICAL_RADIATIVE.formula: Gamma_rad = 0.22233 / lambda_vac_cm^2; air-to-vacuum conversion follows SIR refrax at 15 C, 760 mmHg, zero humidity
SIR2015_CLASSICAL_RADIATIVE.use: reproducible classical radiative damping adopted for high-level consistency with SIR; not represented as a measured upper-level lifetime

SIR2015_STARK_NEGLECT.title: SIR 2015 damping treatment
SIR2015_STARK_NEGLECT.use: Stark broadening is explicitly assumed negligible for this photospheric synthesis; null is a reviewed physical choice rather than missing data
